claude.notes: Full Claude hook set via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} paths. The plugin is the SOLE owner of hook registration; claude/settings.template.json registers none (escapement-ptzz: dual registration double-fired 38 gates). project-bootstrap.sh is repo-resident (scripts/) and is vendored into the plugin like any other hook source. Timeout values converted from milliseconds to seconds.

codex.notes: The plugin is the sole owner of Codex hook registration and ships Escapement-owned session context plus all verified-Codex-safe gates via ${PLUGIN_ROOT} paths. The generated repo .codex/hooks.json is intentionally empty so a plugin install and an Escapement checkout cannot double-fire lifecycle hooks. AGENTS.md and .agents/skills remain repo-local source surfaces and are packaged into the plugin.
